title: Google says its investments in AI are driving more searches

claims.claim: Alphabet'in 2026 yılı 3. çeyrek konsolide gelirleri yıllık bazda yüzde 25 artışla 127,6 milyar dolar olarak gerçekleşti.

evidence.quote: Alphabet’s consolidated revenues for the quarter were $127.6 billion, up 25 percent year-over-year

claims.claim: Google Arama ve diğer hizmetlerinden elde edilen gelirler yıllık bazda yüzde 12 oranında arttı.

evidence.quote: with its “Google Search & other” revenues up 12 percent year-over-year.
Alphabet’s consolidated revenues for the quarter were $127.6 billion, up 25 percent year-over-year, with its “Google Search & other” revenues up 12 percent year-over-year.

claims.claim: Google Cloud geliri yıllık bazda yüzde 103 artarak 30,7 milyar dolara ulaştı.

evidence.quote: Google Cloud revenue was also up 103 percent year-over-year to $30.7 billion.

claims.claim: Google CEO'su Sundar Pichai, yıllık arama sorgusu büyüme oranının son beş yılın en yüksek seviyesinde olduğunu belirtti.

evidence.quote: “In fact, our year-over-year query growth rate is the highest it’s been in the last five years.”

“Our AI investments are driving overall Search query growth, including commercial queries,” CEO Sundar Pichai says in a statement. “In fact, our year-over-year query growth rate is the highest it’s been in the last five years.”

claims.claim: Gemini aylık kullanıcı sayısı 1 milyarı aştı.

evidence.quote: crossing 1 billion monthly users in Gemini
The earnings follow a packed quarter for Google, including the announcement of its Gemini 4 Argon frontier model (which it released widely this month); crossing 1 billion monthly users in Gemini;

claims.claim: Google, Gemini 4 Argon adlı yeni yapay zeka modelini bu ay geniş çapta kullanıma sundu.

evidence.quote: including the announcement of its Gemini 4 Argon frontier model (which it released widely this month)
The earnings follow a packed quarter for Google, including the announcement of its Gemini 4 Argon frontier model (which it released widely this month)

claims.claim: Google, ilk beş Googlebook dizüstü bilgisayar modelini tanıttı.

evidence.quote: the reveal of the first five Googlebook laptops

claims.claim: Eski DeepMind lideri Demis Hassabis, Google'ın yapay zeka liderlik kadrosunda başkanlık görevine getirildi.

evidence.quote: a major shakeup of its top AI leadership that included former DeepMind leader Demis Hassabis stepping into a chair role.
